'''Vaiken Spacedock''' was a massive [[Space station/Legends|space station]] built in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of a [[Unidentified planet (Vaiken Spacedock)|planet]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was named after [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Odile Vaiken]], the father of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Vaiken Spacedock}}</ref>

As befitting its namesake, Vaiken Spacedock was the main staging area of the Imperial Fleet, and was the main hub of [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] bearing Imperial servants to the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], or the [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jiguuna]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> As the Empire's primary military nexus, the station housed a [[Dark Council]] [[Dark Council chamber (Vaiken Spacedock)|chamber]] of its own for purposes of military stratagem and governmental oversight.<ref name="Onslaught" />

The spacedock was protected by a standby [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] consisting of [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts]], [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyers]] and [[Gage-class transport|''Gage''-class transports]]. Additionally, the [[Expeditionary Fleet]] was frequently stationed at Vaiken Spacedock. Notable [[Flagship/Legends|flagships]] of the standby fleet included [[Ziost Shadow]] and [[White Nova (Harrower-class)|White Nova]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> Beside the fleet, Spacedock's defenses also included commonly upgraded state of art shielding technology and detection sensors, as well as a vast arsenal that had a combined destructive power that could potentially lay waste to a small moon.<ref name="codex" />

==Description==
Main level of the Vaiken Spacedock station consisted of four quarters hosting various public offices, constructed around a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the middle, with an elevator leading to a VIP section above it, which periodically hosted [[Slot machine/Legends|slot-machine]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] events. Overlooking the cantina, was a row of private offices and penthouses, encircling the inner hall of the station.<ref name="stronghold">{{TORcite|exp=strongholds|type=other|Vaiken Spacedock Penthouse}}</ref>

[[File:VIPvaiken-SWTOR.png|thumb|VIP area above the central cantina|left|242x242px]]
[[Turbolift/Legends|Turbolifts]] between the quarters lead to various hangars and sub-levels, including starfighter hangars under supervision of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Grenthean]], [[Dark Council]] [[Dark Council chamber (Vaiken Spacedock)|chamber]] level, a prison block and a special hangar refitted for trade, known as "Cartel Bazaar", where representatives of [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Cartel]] and various other parties such as [[Bounty Brokers Association|Broker Bounty Association]], [[The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization|THORN]] or the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] conducted trade. Throughout the station, multiple droids and servants represented Imperial leaders such as [[Darth Nurin]], [[Darth Marr]] or [[Darth Malgus]]; they were tasked with finding able individuals on the station who could assist their masters in various missions.<ref name="SWTOR" />

===Galactic Trade Network quarter===
''Galactic Trade Network quarter'' featured several [[Galactic Market Kiosk]]s, as well as an [[AestheTech Incorporated|AestheTech]] [[Appearance Designer]], storage locker room and multiple shops; a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parts shop run by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raykos]] and [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Brukes]], [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] shop run by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tanij]] and an accessories boutique run by [[Kaiza]] and [[Tahoota]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

===Supplies quarter===
''Supplies quarter'' was dedicated to providing Imperial personnel with weaponry supplies. Many members of [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] oversaw the supply, stationed on Vaiken Spacedock in between various military operations in which they were deployed across the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]]. Notably, this was one of the posts where during the [[Galactic War]] was stationed [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kantis]] with her Sergeants, including [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Kirius]] and Kirius's [[Private/Legends|Privates]], as well as Major [[Emarra]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Thanar]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Leutenants]] [[Noros]], [[Charol]] and [[Mariin]], [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Couli]] and Sergeants [[Damaris]], [[Hirra]] and [[Kanzin]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

The quarter also featured personal office of [[Takanna]], a shop of [[The Force/Legends|force]] artifacts and a cantina-shop in which [[Ki'at Thavo]] and [[Jaleit Nall]] conducted trade.<ref name="SWTOR" />

===Combat Training quarter===
''Combat Training quarter'' featured offices belonging to representatives of the [[Mandalorian enclave|Mandalorian Enclave]], [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] and [[Sith Inquisitor|Sith Inquisitorium]] as well as a personal office of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Hold]]. The quarter was also a location of [[Giradda]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]'s shop and a staging room from where agents of the Empire organized uprisings against the [[Eternal Empire|Eternal Throne]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

===Stronghold quarter===
''Stronghold quarter'' featured multiple [[Stronghold directory terminal]]s for browsing real estate across different planets in the Empire's reach. It was also a place where many home-decor vendors conducted trade; these included [[Necra Phaest]] who had a [[Fabricator Droid]] workshop in the quarter. Three pavilions hosted various vendors in resource trade, and Officer [[Dentan]] had his office in the area, in which [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hathkor]] with droid [[V1C-0RY|V1C-ORY]] were distributing spoils of [[Galactic War|war]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
